analogy.rationale: Glutathione transferase inhibition (annotated target GCLM) perturbs redox homeostasis, so antioxidant/oxidative-stress classes are the closest transcriptional neighbors, but the effect is expected to be weak because these cells have redundant glutathione synthesis and detoxification capacity.
